data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What are the causes of schizophrenia? ASSISTANT:

The causes of schizophrenia are not fully understood. It is believed to be a complex disorder with genetic, environmental, and other factors playing a role. Research suggests that certain changes in the structure and function of the brain may be involved. Symptoms often begin in early adulthood and can include hallucinations, delusions, and disorganized thinking. Treatment typically includes a combination of medications and psychological therapies.
BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How can I live in an abandoned house? ASSISTANT:

It is generally illegal to live in an abandoned house, as the owner of the property still technically owns it and it could pose health risks. If you are interested in rehabilitating an abandoned house, there are resources available to help you.

I would not recommend making loud noises to wake up someone at a sleepover. Instead, a better way to wake someone up is to gently call their name and ask them to wake up.
